sso.title: Celeste samples by stamperadam (Freesound pack 6166), unmodified mirror in peastman/sso
sso.author: stamperadam

format.codec: MPEG-1 Layer III, mono, 44100 Hz, LAME VBR (ffmpeg libmp3lame)
format.gapless: Every file starts with a Xing/Info frame whose LAME tag holds encoderDelay (576) and the per-file padding (zone.padding), so frames * 1152 = encoderDelay + samples + padding.
format.detect: After decodeAudioData, let n = buffer.duration * 44100. Compare n with zone.samples (decoder honoured the gapless tag: shift.gapless), zone.samples + 576 + zone.padding (no trimming: shift.untrimmed) and that + 1152 (the Info frame was decoded as a silent frame: shift.untrimmedWithInfoFrame); use the closest. Add the shift to startOffset, loopStart and loopEnd.

usage.pitch: detune (cents) = (midi - rootMidi) * 100 - tuneCents, i.e. playbackRate = 2 ** ((midi - rootMidi - tuneCents / 100) / 12). tuneCents is how sharp the recording is relative to rootMidi. Unpitched instruments (pitched: false): play at rate 1.
usage.gain: Multiply by zone.gain: it brings every zone of every instrument and layer to the same body loudness, -20 dBFS RMS (RMS of the 0.4 s from the loudest point for one-shots, of the loop for sustains, of +-0.25 s around peakTime for swells). Layers are therefore level-matched and differ only in timbre; apply velocity yourself. instrument.recordedLayerDb gives the level difference the layers had as recorded (e.g. to make soft notes softer still). Files themselves are peak-normalized to -1 dBFS.
usage.timing: All times (startOffset, loopStart, loopEnd, speak, peakTime) are seconds in the decoded buffer of a decoder that honours the LAME gapless tag; add format.shift for other decoders (see format.detect). Onsets sit at startOffset + ~1.5 ms (raised-cosine pre-roll).
usage.loops: Sustain zones: source.loop = true; source.loopStart = loopStart + shift; source.loopEnd = loopEnd + shift; start(t, startOffset + shift); release with a gain ramp. A crossfade is baked in before loopEnd and the audio after loopEnd continues seamlessly from loopStart, so unlooped playback past loopEnd is also click-free.
usage.speak: Sustains: seconds until the note reaches its steady level (-3 dB). Bowed strings speak slowly; start them a little early when the attack must land on a beat.
usage.layers: instrument.layers lists the dynamics present. With one layer, use it for every velocity.
usage.memory: Decoded buffers are float32 at the AudioContext rate: instrument.seconds * sampleRate * 4 bytes (about 0.19 MB per second at 48 kHz). Decode only the instruments a track uses.

celesta.label: Celesta
celesta.note: Spaced-pair KM-184 recording folded to mono.

hornSustain.label: French horn, sustain
hornSustain.note: One horn; layer 2-3 voices on neighbouring zones (detuned 5-8 cents, offset 10-25 ms) for a section.

timpaniRoll.label: Timpani, rolls (loopable)
timpaniRoll.note: Pitch = the same drum's single hit: a roll excites many closely spaced modes, so its spectrum is too diffuse to measure on its own.

cymbalSwell.label: Suspended cymbal, mallet swells
cymbalSwell.note: Schedule start = target time - peakTime so the swell peaks on the beat.
